Dr. Hazel Legaspi, physical therapist here!  I am a holistic movement expert and I help babies and children play and develop so they can explore without limits. I also help parents keep up with all the activities that matter most all while striving for pain-free movements. 

I serve the Whittier, CA and surrounding areas!  I provide mobile (in-home) services. 

Trained in John Barnes #MFR #myofascialrelease and Gillespie Approach #CFT #craniosacralfascialtherapy

I am here for you and your family’s mobility and holistic healing needs.  I am only a phone call away!  562-600-0208
